name: Stormbringer: Tempest's Call hastes the raid and locks it out with Worn Out (#1375)
contract: #1375 Tempest's Call 560567 (SpellFamilyName 22): RecoveryTime 300000 (5 min, matches tooltip), DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms (matches 'for 20 sec'), MaxAffectedTargets 25, ExcludeTargetAuraSpell 804457 ('Worn Out'). Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (6), TargetA 56 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID, RadiusIndex 23 (40 yd), ApplyAuraName 65 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CASTING_SPEED_NOT_STACK, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = 30, handled by AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed (SpellAuraEffects.cpp dispatch line 130), which writes UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED - the field the cast_speed_multiplier metric reads, smaller is faster. Effect[1] is the same effect type, TargetA 56, RadiusIndex 12 (100 yd), ApplyAuraName 192 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE, amount 30, handled by AuraEffect::HandleModMeleeRangedSpeedPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp dispatch line 257), which shortens UNIT_FIELD_BASEATTACKTIME. Effect[2] is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL (64) that applies Worn Out 804457, DurationIndex 5 = 300000 ms, a SPELL_AURA_DUMMY marker with SpellFamilyName 18 (shared across classes). The 5-minute lockout is native: SpellInfo::CheckTarget (src/server/game/Spells/SpellInfo.cpp:2027) drops a unit that already has ExcludeTargetAuraSpell, the field read at SpellInfo.cpp:909, the same mechanism Bloodlust/Heroism use. Decisive corroboration: 520493 'Red Thirst' (Bloodmage, SpellFamilyName 26) is byte-identical in shape - same ExcludeTargetAuraSpell 804457, RecoveryTime 300000, DurationIndex 18, EffectBasePoints[0]=[1]=29, EffectRadiusIndex 23/12/12, ApplyAuraName 65/192, EffectTriggerSpell[2]=804457, MaxAffectedTargets 25 - and already has a committed regression scenario, apps/coa-gameplay-test/scenarios/bloodmage-red-thirst.json, whose contract documents this exact path. This file is that scenario copied verbatim with class 20 -> 16 and spell 520493 -> 560567, keeping 804457 (Worn Out is shared, not class-specific). Two casters are required because the 300000 ms cooldown cannot be cleared with ordinary player permissions: the second caster's Tempest's Call must not reach an ally that is still Worn Out, which the per-caster aura lookup distinguishes. The haste assertions are stated as 'at least 5% faster' because the exact percentage conversion of ApplyCastTimePercentMod and ApplyAttackTimePercentMod was not re-derived for this report, matching the Red Thirst file's own stated limit.
